title: USSOCOM — Brand System + App Marketplace & Dashboard Concepts
goal: Deliver compliant, legible, and extensible identity; explore developer-centric marketplace and personalized dashboards.
summary: Identity refresh under strict standards; vector masters and spec sheets. Concepted app marketplace and user dashboard that centralize tools, access, and knowledge.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Role: Creative Direction & Brand Systems
Domain: Identity, Standards, Multi-media
Scope: Identity exploration → production assets; multi-media applications
Team: [X designers, Y production]
Timeframe: [Q#/Year – Q#/Year]

sections.title: Goal & Constraints
sections.body: Deliver a compliant, legible, extensible identity under strict standards and multi-stakeholder approvals; propose an enablement concept to streamline internal workflows.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
• Org & Ops — Senior stakeholder interviews; approvals cadence; standards governance.
• Research & Insights — Contrast/legibility testing; substrate/production constraints audit.
• Product & IA — Identity system rules (primary/secondary lockups; usage scenarios).
• Design & Systems — Vector masters; export profiles; reproduction specs; enablement platform concept IA (dashboard, app store, knowledge, support).
• Delivery & Quality — Spec documentation; guidance sheets; application kits (coin/flag/merch/digital).
• Stakeholders & Decisions — Review boards; compliance sign-offs; downstream adoption guidance.

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.body: We audited existing standards and real-world reproduction, then set non-negotiables for contrast and fidelity that would scale across print and digital.

sections.title: Mental Models → Systemization
sections.body: We defined how marks adapt across sizes, materials, and digital contexts, and clarified “when to use what” to avoid drift.

sections.title: Information Architecture (Enablement Concept)
sections.body: Mapped an enablement IA: role-based dashboard, app store, systems check, knowledge sharing, support pathways, and personalized workspaces.

sections.title: Prototypes
sections.body: Lockup explorations, contrast tests, and export profiles; concept flows for dashboard and catalog interactions.

sections.title: Operating Mechanisms
sections.body: Usage guardrails, export profiles, and reproduction specs turn standards into repeatable practice.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body:
Consistent, standards-compliant identity with reliable reproduction; clearer enablement pathways via the platform concept.
